sources.snippet: Overview Meta released Llama 3.2-1B-Instruct in September 2024, an instruction-tuned language model optimized for multilingual dialogue, agentic retrieval, and summarization. Despite its small 1 billion parameter footprint, it outperforms many open-source and commercial chat models on industry benchmarks, particularly in instruction following and multilingual reasoning across eight supported ...

sources.title: Llama 3.2 1B Instruct by Meta | The GTM Directory
sources.snippet: Llama 3.2 1B Instruct is Meta's smallest open-weights instruction-tuned chat model, a 1.2B-parameter release built for on-device and edge inference under tight memory constraints. Its standout trait is a 128K-token context window, unusually large for a sub-2B model, paired with high throughput (up to 119 tokens/second) and low latency (0.25s p50). sources.title: Meta: Llama 3.2 1B Instruct - Meta | Model Documentation
sources.snippet: Description Llama 3.2 1B is a 1-billion-parameter language model optimized for efficiently performing natural language tasks such as summarization, dialogue, and multilingual text analysis. With its smaller size, this model allows for efficient operation in low-resource environments while maintaining strong task performance.
